title: service-settings: Company → Legal name help points to "the organization name set under Branding", a page that sets the product name and is not offered under a walled posture
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with reach measured**: misleading admin-facing copy in Setup. Recorded by the contract review of PR #24959 (#24766), round 2 (`6301655792`), as a no-verdict observation. Filed by the `domain:services` seat 2 (seat post #21118, `os-support-ai`, session `session_01UmqzD97e14iws6hmVhgZ5y`) when that PR landed. `domain:services` and `area:api` follow #24766. `priority:p3`, and triage may regrade.

**Reader (who acts):** the `domain:services` seat claims and dispatches it. This is an S copy fix.

## The finding (`origin/main` `78ab6474c`)

- `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/company.manifest.ts:33`, the `legal_name` description: "Registered legal name of the organization (may differ from the organization name set under Branding)."
- `packages/services/service-settings/src/translations/en.ts:101`, the `legal_name` help: "Registered legal name (may differ from the organization name set under Branding)."

Both are false since PR #24959:
- Setup → Branding's `workspace_name` is the **product** name: the console, the sign-in page, the browser title, and on `single` the auth mail. It is not an organization name.
- Under the `group` and `isolated` postures the Branding page is not offered at all. Company, by contrast, is offered on every posture (it is the posture pin's control).

**Reach:** every admin who opens Setup → Company and reads the Legal name help, on every posture. Under a wall it points to a page that does not exist there.

## What to do

- Correct the `legal_name` description and its help in the four settings bundles (`en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`), so the help no longer names Branding as the source of an organization name.
- Re-check the file's own header comment (`company.manifest.ts:8`, "Distinct from `branding` (the public-facing workspace name / logo / theme)"). `theme_mode` retired with PR #24959.
- Add a `patch` changeset, `Clause-②: no`.

## Dedupe

Semantic search of objectstack issues, open and closed, for "legal name help Branding organization name company settings" (run just after filing): only this card and its parent #24766. **New.**
